# Sparkline

Tiny trend line without axes for table cells, Stat tiles and lists: 1.5px ink line, 10 % fill, a dot on the last value; hover shows the value.

`KenosUI.Sparkline` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Sparkline data={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Sparkline" data="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Tiny trend line without axes, e.g. in table cells and Stat tiles; hover shows the value.
